newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa JSE to launch company news feed on Aug 18.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa JSE to launch company news feed on Aug 18.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) said on Thursday it would launch a real time electronic news service to carry corporate announcements from listed South African companies on August 18.
The Stock Exchange News Service (SENS), which will carry price sensitive company news, will be transmitted by the major financial news agencies, including Reuters Holdings Plc.
"SENS will facilitate early, equal and wide dissemination of all information that is expected to have an effect on the prices of securities that trade on the JSE," the exchange said in a statement.

SENS, which is expected to transmit information daily from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. (0600 to 1600 GMT), will have a two-month phasing-in period during which companies will not be obliged to use it. The requirement to release announcements through SENS will become obligatory from October 15.
Announcements will be published in the press the following day.
The JSE said that the data would not be available on its electronic trading system, JET, although a five-minute warning that an announcement was due to be made would be posted on that system.
In launching SENS, the JSE follows the example of other bourses worldwide, including the London Stock Exchange.
The birth of SENS makes necessary changes to the JSE's listings requirements. The bourse has compiled a document on guidelines for the dissemination of price sensitive information.
